items.name: logs-ui
items.title: NocoBase Notification Logs UI
items.description: Application-owned delivery and provider attempt log components backed by the NocoBase notification API.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-notification and its access-controlled /api/notifications/logs route. The plugin now provides /settings/notifications/logs by default; install this application-owned source only when the application needs to maintain a custom log page.
